task.evidence: 22 January – A Casspir of the Indian Army falls into a gorge in Doda, Jammu and Kashmir, killing 10 soldiers and injuring 10 others.

answer: FINAL: The death toll from the Casspir incident in Doda, Jammu and Kashmir in January 2026 was 10 soldiers killed (with an additional 10 others injured). The incident occurred on January 22, 2026, when a Casspir vehicle of the Indian Army fell into a gorge.
